verdict.rationale: Mollie is API-first: every core resource (payments, subscriptions, refunds, balances, webhooks) is driven through its own API. Scoped API keys and advanced tokens suit unattended automation, and an isolated test mode, selectable by test key or `testmode` parameter, plus Idempotency-Key retries make CI runs safe. Test-mode checkout and state simulation are documented as walk-through flows rather than clearly programmatic ones, and there is no CLI or CI guidance. missing for 10: an official CLI or documented CI/headless recipes, fully programmatic (non-interactive) test payment state transitions, independent hands-on corroboration.
